title: Super Easy Anvils
description: This project adds a really easy recipe for anvils, at the cost of having lower durability
body:
# Easy anvils
This super easy anvil recipe - only requireing 3 pieces of iron, but it makes a damaged anvil, rather than a normal one - this anvil has durability compared to other anvils.
![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73de4a54f3de8d6e4754979a58e00b88323a0c1c.png)
Because the recipe makes damaged anvils, this makes it easier to make cheap anvil traps, as they instantly break on impact with the floor.
